author: Pinal County AZ Daily Brief
title: 🚌 Multiple Transportation Jobs Now Hiring in Pinal County, AZ - NewsBreak
text:
12 hours ago Pinal County’s transportation scene is rolling with new opportunities this month. Whether you’re just starting out or already have your CDL, there’s a solid mix of local driving and equipment roles open right now.
Commercial Driver – Full Time Employer: AutoZone
Location: Apache Junction, AZ
Type: Full-time
Put your safe driving skills to work delivering auto parts to local customers—no CDL required. AutoZone offers competitive pay, benefits, and career growth in a stable, essential industry.
Heavy Equipment Operator or Trainee – Casa Grande Employer: Pinal County
Location: Florence, AZ
Type: Full-time
Start at $34,500–$39,411 depending on experience. Join the county’s Public Works team maintaining roads and infrastructure. Great benefits include paid vacation, retirement plans, and tuition reimbursement —plus a clear path from trainee to operator.
Part-Time CDL Delivery Driver Employer: Lowe’s Companies, Inc.
Location: Maricopa, AZ
Type: Part-time
Drive local deliveries for a trusted home improvement brand. Requires a Class A or B CDL and offers hands-on work with customers and products. Ideal for drivers wanting flexible hours and steady work.
